name: The End Of The Earth
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator and Sustainer of the earth, having established its foundations so it cannot be moved or removed (Psalms 93:1; Psalms 104:5). He alone stretched out the heavens and spread abroad the earth by His own power (Isaiah 40:22; Isaiah 44:24). His authority extends to the ends of the earth, over which He looks and reigns with majesty (Job 28:24; Psalms 93:1), affirming His eternal and unchanging dominion over all creation from the very beginning (Genesis 1:1).
